title: KRAHN Chemie GmbH
content:
KRAHN Chemie is a major European specialty chemicals distributor with a strong regional footprint across central Europe. The company distributes aerogel materials for formulation, coatings, and insulation-related applications while also providing technical sales support.

  • Coverage Area: Germany, Austria, Poland, and Italy
  • Focus Areas: Aerogel powders for coatings, thermal-insulation additives, construction materials, and industrial formulations
  • Current Brands Represented: Svenska Aerogel (Quartzene®)
  • Official Website: https://www.krahn.eu/en
review_notes: Directory profile reviewed for listing quality, category fit, and current public website availability.
